@graph.description:
Reinterpretation of nav2's error_codes system test
(nav2_system_tests/src/error_codes, jazzy). Where upstream launches only
controller_server, planner_server and smoother_server with custom C++ error-code
plugins, this campaign runs the full nav2 stack (files/nav2_stack.launch.py, the
same world as the sibling system_failure/test_failure_navigator.vast) and triggers
STOCK error codes that nav2 emits without any custom plugin: requesting a
non-existent controller/planner/smoother plugin id, or sending a goal the server
rejects for a stock reason.

MEANING OF A CELL: one configuration is one upstream error-code test case
(error_codes.csv lines 32-37). The trial is a single direct action-call that the
server ABORTS with the error code in result.error_code, so action_call returns
FAILURE and every cell carries expect_success: false. The analysis verifies the
specific error_code from the recorded /<action>/_action/status messages (which
contain result.error_code). expect_success being inverted is a graded-with correct
fact, not a broken campaign -- see scenario_nav2_behavior_test.osc's header for the
same mechanism.

PORTED CASE -> ERROR CODE:
- FollowPath (CSV line 32)  -> controller_id that no plugin matches -> INVALID_CONTROLLER (stock)
- ComputePathToPose success/cancel (lines 33-34) -> planner_id that no plugin matches -> INVALID_PLANNER (stock)
- ComputePathThroughPoses success/cancel (lines 35-36) -> empty goals -> NO_VIAPOINTS_GIVEN (stock)
- SmoothPath (line 37)      -> smoother_id that no plugin matches -> INVALID_SMOOTHER (stock)

NOT PORTED, each because the substrate cannot express it today -- recorded rather
than faked (see readme.md for the full list and reasons):
- The two CANCEL cases (lines 34 and 36). action_call (the ONLY way to drive an
  action in this scenario framework, which has no FollowPath/ComputePath* typed
  actions) has no cancel entry point; RosActionCall.shutdown() cancels only at
  scenario teardown.
- The error codes that need a custom plugin goal or state (UNKNOWN, TF_ERROR,
  PATIENCE_EXCEEDED, FAILED_TO_MAKE_PROGRESS, NO_VALID_CONTROL, CONTROLLER_TIMED_OUT,
  START/GOAL_OCCUPIED, outside-map-bounds, INVALID_PATH, SMOOTHED_PATH_IN_COLLISION,
  FAILED_TO_SMOOTH_PATH). Each is listed in readme.md with why the stock stack
  cannot be made to emit it deterministically in a single scenario trial.
